author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered is available now Nintendo Switch™ 2, giving players a brand-new way to explore Cyrodiil.

Whether you’re stepping into Oblivion realm or battling warriors in Imperial City Arena, features like Joy-Con™ 2 motion controls, mouse and touchscreen mode, and traditional input options are built to support the future Heroes of Kvatch.
